The '''Tamarin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] near the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Alis Point]], [[Baffop]], [[Bengely]], [[Garis]], [[Kirdo III/Legends|Kirdo III]], [[Rior/Legends|Rior]], [[Sevarcos II]] and [[Z'trop]].

It also contained the [[Imperial Research and Development Station T-1583]], the [[Dravian Starport]], the [[Rantine Space Station/Legends|Rantine Space Station]], [[Viraxo 54]], the [[Camen Spaceport]] and the [[Saruwen Station]].

==History==
By the time of the [[Bordal Contagion]] of [[214 BBY]], the Tamarin sector was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However the Republic authority had ceased to exist beyond [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] and the Tamarin and neighboring [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] had fallen into anarchy. The region had become a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] heaven and [[Planetary Security Forces]] were outgunned by them. The Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Tamarin sector was a [[spice lord]] from [[Sevarcos II]] and his [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] was only assigned to protect [[Spice/Legends|spice]] haulers.<ref name="EGW-cut6" />

But following the Bordal Contagion, various organizations in both sectors, including the [[Ma'ar Shaddam Weaponsmiths Guild]], [[Kett Shipping]], [[Rseikharhl Hullspace]] and [[Cotellieri Transports Limited]] decided to arrange a meeting with a representative from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. After a single [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of meeting on [[Syned]], the organizations agreed to become members of the Federation. Shortly afterward, [[Warship/Legends|warships]] from the [[Trade Defense Force]] overwhelmed the pirates in the area. Eventually the Trade Federation took control over the entire Rseik and Tamarin sectors.<ref name="EGW-cut6" />

It was ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lobax Resuun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Chaos erupted in the sector following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Challenged by fledgling planetary governments, Moff Resuun was also forced to struggle against the demoralization of the remaining [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and the expending criminality. Organized crime had grown from small time gun-runners and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to a powerful economizing military force throughout the sector. The Moff headquarters and the sectorial government were eventually relocated to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Retribution (Imperial-class)|''Retribution'']].<ref name="TAoB" />

Moff Resuun managed to maintained enough power and influence to avoid any open revolution against the Empire until the actions of [[Sard Nightbringer]], the most powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the sector. She was determined to force the Empire out of the sector and take over the government. Nightbringer managed to invade the Imperial R&D Station T-1583 and steal experimental technology but she was eventually killed by [[Marg Sonat|her second]].<ref name="TAoB" />
